physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: Initial untried candidate: retain the qualified baseline physical configuration and enable both protocol-approved RTL actions. The only captured measured result is the baseline: standard-cell area 161954 um2, setup slack 0.19292 ns, hold slack 0.114491 ns, zero max-slew/max-cap/max-fanout violations, and physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible all true. Exact signed 18-bit reduction with sign extension targets redundant arithmetic area and capacitance; request-qualified multiply operand isolation targets switching outside accepted requests. Their effects are hypotheses pending measurement: masking adds gates and input delay, and placement, repair and buffering can offset savings. Retaining utilization 40, density 0.55, abc_area 0 and repair_margin 0 avoids simultaneously risking area-oriented mapping or denser placement with this limited baseline timing margin. Optimize Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geomean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6), where lower qualified Q is better; die-area reduction alone earns no benefit. Evaluation must report actual configuration and actions, cell_area_um2, die_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, failure_classes, physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, each workload energy_j, activity and parasitic annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score and execution costs. Retain failures and costs and compare only qualified measurements against the incumbent; no candidate area, energy or score is claimed here. Energy interpretation remains the baseline Liberty-model estimate from zero-delay post-route activity and extracted SPEF, without SDF/glitch or silicon-power claims.
